Jordan (Sales): MeridianBank POC: they want a SOC 2 excerpt, signed pen-test attestation, and a short-lived private dataroom with redacted KMS topology. Need turnaround in ~48h. Also asking if a 2-week Dedicated trial changes pricing.

Alex Chen: We can produce a redacted SOC2 excerpt and our pen-test attestation template. For signed letters we need an NDA + named signatory (name, title, email). We do NOT share raw vuln scan files or private keys.

Priya N: Dataroom provisioning requires the assurance form + NDA attached. Use https://redwood.example.com/assurance/dataroom-request and include TTL, customer contact, and signatory. Network/KMS diagrams must be redacted (no internal IPs or keys).

Sam R: Pricing note: Hosted POC can use free credits; Dedicated requires a short-term reserved commit and a quote from finance. I can produce a one-page estimate for a 2-week Dedicated pool (ETA ~2h).

Alex Chen: Paste to security to speed it up:

```
To: security@redwood.com
Subject: MeridianBank - Dataroom + Pen-test Signatory
Customer: MeridianBank
Contact: ciso@meridianbank.com
Signatory: Jane Doe, CISO, jane.doe@meridianbank.com
NDA: attached
Artifacts: SOC2 excerpt (redacted), redacted KMS topology
TTL: 14 days
```

Security Ops Bot: Ticket SEC-2026-874 created. Dataroom provisioning queued; SLA ~1 business day.

Jordan (Sales): I'll request NDA/signatory now and loop in procurement. @Sam R please post the Dedicated trial estimate when ready.

Sam R: Will share estimate in ~2h.
